column3: The Hebrew calls the sea “the rear sea”; BSB says “the Western Sea.”
The Hebrew uses the image of “your seed”; BSB says “your descendants.”
The Hebrew says “by the mouth of the LORD”; BSB says “as the LORD had said.”
The Hebrew names his burial or grave without a separate word “location”; BSB specifies “the location of his grave.”
The Hebrew has singular “his eye”; BSB has plural “his eyes.”
The Hebrew says Joshua was full of the spirit of wisdom; BSB has the passive “was filled.”
The Hebrew does not repeat “no prophet” or explicitly name Moses here; BSB supplies “no prophet” and names Moses as the one sent.
The Hebrew names “the strong hand” and “the great terror” and repeats “all”; BSB expands these to “mighty acts of power and awesome deeds” and supplies “no prophet.”
